title: Beside Vs Besides
theory:
 Beside means 'by the side of or next to' (osQ ikl ;k cxy esa)
  Besides means 'in addition to or apart from' (osQ vykok)
 Note- Besides is used as both Preposition and Adverb.

 Beside Besides

 Preposition Preposition Adverb

 Example

 1 Besides English, the students used to speak Hindi fluently.

 Preposition

 2 The dog was sitting beside the chair.

 Preposition

 3 It is too late, besides we have no money.

 Adverb

 4 The task is very difficult, besides we have little time left.

 Adverb

 5 Besides working full time, she is pursuing her studies.

 Preposition
